title: Show HN: Reladraw – A diagram language where you decide where to place things
summary: Reladraw is a diagram definition language that allows users to write diagram code while maintaining precise control over element placement, unlike auto-layout tools (Mermaid/Graphviz) that sacrifice visual control, and unlike GUI tools (Draw.io) that are time-consuming and hard to automate.
problem_solved: Addresses the trade-off between code-based diagram tools that auto-place elements and GUI tools that require manual manipulation but are inefficient to script or automate.
why_valuable: It gives developers the best of both worlds: the efficiency and version-control friendliness of code-based diagrams with the visual precision of manual design tools.
